messages:
Samira CSM: Heads up — VelocityCorp usage dipped ~65% this week, renewal in 18 days. leaning red on health. suspect onboarding friction on rate-limited endpoints. Need quick save plan.
Alex PS: :eyes: saw the spike in token errors last Thurs. logs show a bunch of 429s from a single integration key.
Priya (Enablement): I can do a 20-min microenable session this Thurs to walk through best-practices + config tweaks. proposed agenda: shard keys, batch config, and sample prompts.
Nikhil (RevOps): Can we push a short reduction offer if they still downgrade? maybe a 2-week discount + dedicated enablement. need legal ok.
onboarding-bot: [Alert] Account VelocityCorp triggered "onboard-friction" at 2026-03-20T14:12:02Z
Samira CSM: Plan proposal — "Tiered save circuit": 1) Immediate triage call (me + Alex) to remove 429 root. 2) Microenable session w/ Priya within 72h. 3) Temp usage credit + 2-week price protection if they commit to enablement.
Alex PS: Triage checklist for call:
```
- Pull last 48h request logs (filter by API key)
- Check rate limit headers & burst pattern
- Test with sample payloads (seq len / batch size)
- Apply quick-fix: increase per-key quota or suggest retry/backoff
```
Priya (Enablement): I'll draft the 20-min deck + a 3-step change log for their devs. also include this short in-product checklist we can paste into their workspace.
Samira CSM: I'll send the customer invite — quick script below. please review:
```
Hi Jane,
We noticed a drop in usage and want to help quickly — can you join a 20-min session on Thurs to optimize your integration? We'll run a short checklist, remove any rate-limit issues, and offer a 2-week usage credit if you do the session.
Available slots: Thu 10:00, Thu 15:00, Fri 11:00
— Samira
```
Nikhil (RevOps): Approve provisional 2-week credit pending CSM signoff. I'll queue a billing note. :+1:
Samira CSM: Assigning owners: triage call — Alex; microenable — Priya; billing credit — Nikhil. I'll update this thread after the triage.
Alex PS: On it — will run logs now and post findings here.
Samira CSM: Great. target: reduce downgrade risk by >50% this week. :crossed_fingers:
